title: lint: the visibility-predicate rules run at the runtime save door for a view but not for a page, so a page visibleWhen calling an unknown function is saved through Studio, REST or MCP and refused only by os validate (ruling B on #23388's principle)
body:
Filing gate ①, class (a): the same rule is enforced at one door and not at the other door that accepts the same metadata. Found by the dev of #24414 (`os-dev-report` 6261064791, out-of-scope finding) and confirmed by PR #24478's `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` record 6261910322 (③, "meets a filing gate"). Filed by `domain:engine` seat 1 (seat post #6367) for the lane that owns `packages/lint`. ⛔ Not a claim.

- **`reach:`** the registry rows themselves (contract text), read on `origin/main`; no booted save was run.
  - `validateVisibilityPredicates` and its sibling entry are registered with `surfaces: CLI_AND_RUNTIME` and `runtimeTypes: ['view']` (`packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts`, about `:1593`–`:1594` and `:1631`–`:1632`).
  - `runtimeAuthoringRulesFor(type)` (`packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.ts`) filters on `runtimeTypes`. So for a `page` written through the runtime save door (Studio, `PUT /api/v1/meta/page/:name`, MCP), the visibility-predicate family does not run.
  - The dev's lint-level probe ran the four rules the runtime gate does run for `page` on a page component `visibleWhen` of `totallyBogusFn(1)`. It drew no function-existence finding. `os validate`, `os lint` and `os build` refuse the same predicate.
  - The entry's own comment block (#7220) says the rule reads `stack.pages`.
- **Why it is this lane's now:** ruling 6161173492 on #23388 (letter B, the maintainer: 「如果页面有问题，不是应该修改了再保存吗？」) moved the two page component rules (`validateComponentProps`, `validateComponentTypes`) to the runtime door with `runtimeTypes: ['page']` (PR #23418). Its principle is that a page with a finding is fixed, then saved, so one rule holds at every door that accepts a page. The visibility-predicate family was not part of that ruling's two rules and still declares `view` only.
- **The trap:** an AI writing a page through MCP gets `200` for a `visibleWhen` that faults at render, and a faulting predicate renders the component, so the gate silently never gates.
- **Reader who acts:** triage grades it and confirms the lane (`packages/lint`, `domain:spec`).
  - The shape the review names: `runtimeTypes: ['view', 'page']` on both entries, plus a pin at the real runtime door (`saveMetaItem` for a `page`) that refuses an unknown function in a page component `visibleWhen` and admits a registered one.
  - A narrowing of the metadata save door, so `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, BREAKING, and the protocol-first grade.
  - Whether stored pages carrying such a predicate need the stored preview first is the lane's call under ruling B, which read that gap as closed for the two component rules.
- **Dedupe:** two semantic searches over this repository's issues, closed included, found no card for this position:
  - "page visibleWhen unknown function not refused at runtime save door, validateVisibilityPredicates runtimeTypes view only page": 18 hits;
  - "runtime authoring gate page type visibility predicate lint Studio REST meta save page component predicate admitted": 17 hits.

  The nearest are #23388 and PR #23418 (closed: the two component rules only), #23357 (closed: a page component's retired `data` source), and #22032 (closed: the object save door's predicate verdicts).

Dedupe words: page visibleWhen runtime save door, runtimeTypes page visibility, unknown function page predicate, validateVisibilityPredicates runtimeTypes.
